cond_0001.intro: The position requires the individual to apply their technical knowledge and experience for the successful database programming and custom graphics development and subsequent installation of this programming into the Building Management System for all assigned projects. Additionally this role supports the startup, commissioning and trouble-shooting of the assigned projects. The position requires a high level of experience in computer skills and the understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types. This role will also require responsibility for documenting all fields as built conditions, as well as, the commissioning process documents. The position is required to closely interact with the Project Manager and any assigned Project Engineering staff to assist with the timely and successful completion of each project.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases & programs.
Supports the execution of the initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities
Performs the troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute the pre-functional testing of the system software code in relationship to the design sequence of operations.
Participates and supports the final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED and Title 24 testing as required.
Possesses the knowledge of multiple vendor software versions
Develops and utilizes the skill set to effectively work with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems and protocols.
Maintains a lead role in the field coordination of installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Responsible for attending required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by the assigned projects.
Participates and leads all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.
Responsible for the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Assists Design Engineers with the validation of sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Coordinates with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
Provides the necessary leadership role for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicates effectively with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Attends and successfully completes the OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Responsible for practicing safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and that of any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.
Responsible for coaching, mentoring and development of junior level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2–5 Years of related work experience in building automation systems, or an Associate's degree in a technical field
2–5 Years experience in automation control systems, HVAC, construction, block coding, testing of system SW code, and Building Management Systems
Experience with LEED and Title 24
Must possess a valid driver's license
Must be highly organized with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet schedules given by leadership
Ability to operate independently and autonomously and take ownership of all assigned tasks
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
Strong mechanical aptitude and any technical school training

Basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation

The role requires strong computer skills and an understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types. You will coordinate closely with the Project Manager and assigned Project Engineering staff to help ensure the timely and successful completion of each project.
cond_0045.responsibilities:
Collaborate with the team as a lead Systems Software Engineer in developing lower and mid-level control systems databases and programs.
Support the execution of initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities.
Work with the team to troubleshoot local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Use computer hardware and software to support and help execute pre-functional testing of system software code in relation to the design sequence of operations.
Participate and support final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED, and Title 24 testing as required.
Maintain knowledge of multiple vendor software versions.
Work with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems, and protocols.
Coordinate field activities with installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Attend required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by assigned projects.
Participate in and help facilitate all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.
Coordinate the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Assist Design Engineers in validating sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Work with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
Help manage field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
Provide leadership support for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Share updates and communicate effectively with team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Attend and complete OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Practice safe work habits and participate in office safety program requirements and any specific safety requirements of assigned projects.
Support the coaching, mentoring, and development of junior level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0045.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Associate's degree in a technical field or 2–5 years of related work experience in building automation systems
2–5 Years of experience in automation control systems, HVAC, construction, block coding, system SW code testing, and Building Management Systems
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, and file structure; basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation
Strong mechanical aptitude and technical school training
Must be highly organized with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet schedules
Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks
Valid driver's license
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
Experience with LEED and Title 24

Additionally this role supports the startup, commissioning and trouble-shooting of the assigned projects. The position requires a high level of experience in computer skills and the understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types. This role will also require responsibility for documenting all fields as built conditions, as well as, the commissioning process documents. The position is required to closely interact with the Project Manager and any assigned Project Engineering staff to assist with the timely and successful completion of each project.
cond_0100.responsibilities:
Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases & programs.
Supports the execution of the initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities
Performs the troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute the pre-functional testing of the system software code in relationship to the design sequence of operations.
Participates and supports the final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED and Title 24 testing as required.
Possesses the knowledge of multiple vendor software versions
Develops and utilizes the skill set to effectively work with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems and protocols.
Maintains a lead role in the field coordination of installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Responsible for attending required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by the assigned projects.
Participates and leads all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.
Responsible for the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Assists Design Engineers with the validation of sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Coordinates with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
Provides the necessary leadership role for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicates effectively with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Attends and successfully completes the OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Responsible for practicing safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and that of any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.
Responsible for coaching, mentoring and development of junior level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0100.requirements:
Associates degree in a technical field or 2-5 years of related work experience in building automation systems. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering preferred.
Strong mechanical aptitude and any technical school training.
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, File Structure. Basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation are desired.
Must be highly organized and possess the ability to work in a high paced environment with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet the schedules given by leadership.
Has the ability to operate independently and autonomously and take ownership of all assigned tasks.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
2 - 5 Yrs experience, automation control systems, LEED, Title 24, construction, HVAC, block coding, testing of the system SW code, Building Management System

This role also supports startup, commissioning, and troubleshooting of assigned projects. It requires a high level of computer skills and understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types. The role also involves documenting all field as-built conditions and commissioning process documents. You will regularly interact with the Project Manager and any assigned Project Engineering staff to help ensure the timely and successful completion of each project.
cond_0213.responsibilities:
Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases and programs.
Actively supports the execution of initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities.
Performs troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute pre-functional testing of system software code in relation to the design sequence of operations.
Participates in and supports final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED, and Title 24 testing as required.
Maintains knowledge of multiple vendor software versions.
Develops and applies skills to work directly with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems, and protocols.
Takes a lead role in field coordination with installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Attends required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by assigned projects.
Leads and participates in all end user/customer system training on assigned projects.
Responsible for the systematic handover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Works closely with Design Engineers to validate sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Coordinates regularly with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
Provides leadership for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicates directly and regularly with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Attends and successfully completes OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Practices safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.
Responsible for coaching, mentoring, and developing junior level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0213.requirements:
Associates degree in a technical field or 2–5 years of related work experience in building automation systems. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering preferred.
Strong mechanical aptitude and any technical school training.
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, and file structure. Basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation are desired.
Must be highly organized with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet schedules given by leadership.
Able to work independently and take ownership of all assigned tasks.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
2–5 Years of experience in automation control systems, LEED, Title 24, construction, HVAC, block coding, testing of system software code, and Building Management Systems.

cond_0231.intro: The position requires applying technical knowledge and experience for database programming and custom graphics development, and the subsequent installation of this programming into the Building Management System for all assigned projects. This role also supports startup, commissioning, and troubleshooting of assigned projects. It requires a high level of computer skills and understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types. The role also involves documenting all field as-built conditions and commissioning process documents. You will regularly interact with the Project Manager and any assigned Project Engineering staff to help ensure the timely and successful completion of each project.
cond_0231.responsibilities:
Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases and programs.
Actively supports the execution of initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities.
Performs troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute pre-functional testing of system software code in relation to the design sequence of operations.
Participates in and supports final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED, and Title 24 testing as required.
Maintains knowledge of multiple vendor software versions.
Develops and applies skills to work directly with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems, and protocols.
Takes a lead role in field coordination with installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Attends required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by assigned projects.
Leads and participates in all end user/customer system training on assigned projects.
Responsible for the systematic handover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Works closely with Design Engineers to validate sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Coordinates regularly with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
Provides leadership for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicates directly and regularly with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Attends and successfully completes OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Practices safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.
Responsible for coaching, mentoring, and developing junior level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0231.requirements:
Associates degree in a technical field or 2–5 years of related work experience in building automation systems. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering preferred.
Strong mechanical aptitude and any technical school training.
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, and file structure. Basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation are desired.
Must be highly organized with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet schedules given by leadership.
Able to work independently and take ownership of all assigned tasks.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
2–5 Years of experience in automation control systems, LEED, Title 24, construction, HVAC, block coding, testing of system software code, and Building Management Systems.

cond_0240.intro: The position requires applying technical knowledge and experience for database programming, custom graphics development, and installation of programming into the Building Management System for all assigned projects. This role also supports startup, commissioning, and troubleshooting of assigned projects. A high level of computer skills and understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types, is required. The role also involves documenting all field as-built conditions and commissioning process documents. You will regularly interact with the Project Manager and assigned Project Engineering staff to help ensure the timely and successful completion of each project.
cond_0240.responsibilities:
Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases and programs.
Supports the execution of the initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities.
Performs troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute pre-functional testing of system software code in relation to the design sequence of operations.
Participates in and supports final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED, and Title 24 testing as required.
Possesses knowledge of multiple vendor software versions.
Develops and applies skills to actively work with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems, and protocols.
Maintains a lead role in field coordination with installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Attends required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings for assigned projects, and actively contributes to discussions on project issues and decisions.
Leads all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.
Responsible for the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Assists Design Engineers with validation of sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Coordinates regularly with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
Provides leadership for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicates directly and regularly with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Attends and successfully completes OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Practices safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.
Responsible for coaching, mentoring, and development of junior level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0240.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2–5 Years of related work experience in building automation systems, or an Associate's degree in a technical field.
2–5 Years of experience with automation control systems, HVAC, Building Management System, block coding, and testing of system software code.
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, and file structure; basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation.
Must be highly organized with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet schedules set by leadership.
Ability to operate independently and take ownership of all assigned tasks.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Strong mechanical aptitude and technical school training.
Experience with LEED, Title 24, and construction environments.

Communicates clearly with team members on project issues, obstacles, and information needs.

cond_0312.intro: The position requires applying technical knowledge and experience for database programming, custom graphics development, and installation of programming into the Building Management System for all assigned projects. This role also supports startup, commissioning, and troubleshooting of assigned projects. A high level of computer skills and understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types, is required. The role also involves documenting all field as-built conditions and commissioning process documents. You will regularly interact with the Project Manager and assigned Project Engineering staff to help ensure the timely and successful completion of each project.
cond_0312.responsibilities:
Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases and programs.
Supports the execution of the initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities.
Performs troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute pre-functional testing of system software code in relation to the design sequence of operations.
Participates in and supports final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED, and Title 24 testing as required.
Possesses knowledge of multiple vendor software versions.
Develops and applies skills to actively work with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems, and protocols.
Maintains a lead role in field coordination with installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Attends required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings for assigned projects, and actively contributes to discussions on project issues and decisions.
Leads all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.
Responsible for the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Assists Design Engineers with validation of sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Coordinates regularly with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
Provides leadership for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicates directly and regularly with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Attends and successfully completes OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Practices safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.
Responsible for coaching, mentoring, and development of junior level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0312.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2–5 Years of related work experience in building automation systems, or an Associate's degree in a technical field.
2–5 Years of experience with automation control systems, HVAC, Building Management System, block coding, and testing of system software code.
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, and file structure; basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation.
Must be highly organized with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet schedules set by leadership.
Ability to operate independently and take ownership of all assigned tasks.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Strong mechanical aptitude and technical school training.
Experience with LEED, Title 24, and construction environments.

cond_0359.intro: This role requires applying technical knowledge and experience to deliver successful database programming and custom graphics development, and to execute the installation of this programming into the Building Management System for all assigned projects. You will also own the startup, commissioning, and troubleshooting of assigned projects. The role demands strong computer skills and a solid understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types. You will be accountable for documenting all field as-built conditions and commissioning process documents, and will work closely with the Project Manager and any assigned Project Engineering staff to drive the timely and successful completion of each project.
cond_0359.responsibilities:
Lead the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases and programs as a lead Systems Software Engineer.
Direct the initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities.
Troubleshoot local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Execute pre-functional testing of system software code against the design sequence of operations using computer hardware and software.
Lead final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED, and Title 24 testing as required.
Maintain knowledge of multiple vendor software versions.
Develop and apply skills to manage 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems, and protocols.
Take a lead role in field coordination of installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Attend required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings for assigned projects.
Lead all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.
Own the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Assist Design Engineers with validation of sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc., in coordination with project staff.
Manage field time and budgets for assigned projects.
Provide leadership for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicate effectively with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Complete OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Uphold safe work habits and meet office safety program requirements and any project-specific safety requirements.
Coach, mentor, and develop junior-level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0359.requirements:
Associates degree in a technical field or 2-5 years of related work experience in building automation systems. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering preferred.
Strong mechanical aptitude and any technical school training.
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, File Structure. Basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation are desired.
Must be highly organized with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet schedules given by leadership.
Able to operate independently and autonomously and take ownership of all assigned tasks.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
2-5 Years experience in automation control systems, LEED, Title 24, construction, HVAC, block coding, testing of system software code, and Building Management Systems.

The position requires a high level of experience in computer skills and the understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types. This role will also require responsibility for documenting all fields as built conditions, as well as, the commissioning process documents. The position is required to closely interact with the Project Manager and any assigned Project Engineering staff to assist with the timely and successful completion of each project. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp building automation systems and the logic behind how control systems come together.
cond_0463.responsibilities:
Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases & programs.
Supports the execution of the initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities
Performs the troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute the pre-functional testing of the system software code in relationship to the design sequence of operations.
Participates and supports the final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED and Title 24 testing as required.
Possesses the knowledge of multiple vendor software versions
Develops and utilizes the skill set to effectively work with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems and protocols.
Maintains a lead role in the field coordination of installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Responsible for attending required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by the assigned projects.
Participates and leads all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.
Responsible for the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Assists Design Engineers with the validation of sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Coordinates with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
Provides the necessary leadership role for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicates effectively with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Attends and successfully completes the OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Responsible for practicing safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and that of any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.
Responsible for coaching, mentoring and development of junior level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0463.requirements:
Associates degree in a technical field or 2-5 years of related work experience in building automation systems. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering preferred.
Strong mechanical aptitude and any technical school training.
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, File Structure. Basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation are desired.
Must be highly organized and possess the ability to work in a high paced environment with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet the schedules given by leadership.
Has the ability to operate independently and autonomously and take ownership of all assigned tasks.
Must possess a valid driver's license.
2 - 5 Yrs experience, automation control systems, LEED, Title 24, construction, HVAC, block coding, testing of the system SW code, Building Management System

cond_0509.intro: The position requires applying technical knowledge and experience for database programming, custom graphics development, and installation of programming into the Building Management System for all assigned projects. This role also supports startup, commissioning, and troubleshooting of assigned projects. It requires strong computer skills and an understanding of computer-operated systems, including network types. The role includes documenting all field as-built conditions and commissioning process documents, and requires close interaction with the Project Manager and any assigned Project Engineering staff to support timely and successful project completion. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with building automation systems and controls work.
cond_0509.responsibilities:
Performs as a lead Systems Software Engineer in the development of lower and mid-level control systems databases & programs.
Supports the execution of the initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities.
Performs the troubleshooting of local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Utilizes computer hardware and software to support and/or execute the pre-functional testing of the system software code in relationship to the design sequence of operations.
Participates and supports the final systems functional testing relative to standard, 3rd party, LEED and Title 24 testing as required.
Possesses the knowledge of multiple vendor software versions.
Develops and utilizes the skill set to effectively work with 3rd party integrations of other vendor products, systems and protocols.
Maintains a lead role in the field coordination of installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned to the project.
Responsible for attending required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by the assigned projects.
Participates and leads all end user/customer system training requirements on assigned projects.
Responsible for the systematic turnover of the project from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Assists Design Engineers with the validation of sequence of operations development against design build and/or contract requirements.
Coordinates with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs including time sheets, daily reports, etc.
Manages field time and budgets relative to the field work of assigned projects.
Provides the necessary leadership role for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicates effectively with other team members regarding project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Attends and successfully completes the OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training classes.
Responsible for practicing safe work habits and participates in office safety program requirements and that of any specific safety requirements of all assigned projects.
Responsible for coaching, mentoring and development of junior level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0509.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2–5 Years of experience in automation control systems, building automation systems, HVAC, construction, LEED, Title 24, block coding, and testing of system software code
Experience with Building Management Systems
Associates degree in a technical field or 2–5 years of related work experience in building automation systems
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, and file structure
Basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation
Must be highly organized with the ability to prioritize tasks to meet schedules given by leadership
Ability to operate independently and take ownership of all assigned tasks
Must possess a valid driver's license
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
Strong mechanical aptitude and any technical school training

This role requires automation and control systems experience to develop building-wide control systems, such as HVAC, lighting, alarms, and security access and cameras, converging these systems into a single IT-managed network infrastructure to create a smart building.
The position involves database programming, custom graphics development, and installation of programming into the Building Management System for assigned projects. It also supports startup, commissioning, and troubleshooting. A solid background in computer skills and computer-operated systems, including network types, is required. The role includes documenting all field as-built conditions and commissioning process documents. Coordination with the Project Manager and assigned Project Engineering staff is required to support timely project completion.
cond_0529.responsibilities:
Serves as lead Systems Software Engineer in developing lower and mid-level control systems databases and programs.
Supports execution of initial systems point-to-point commissioning activities.
Troubleshoots local and wide area network issues as they arise.
Uses computer hardware and software to support or execute pre-functional testing of system software code against the design sequence of operations.
Participates in final systems functional testing relative to standard, third-party, LEED, and Title 24 requirements.
Maintains working knowledge of multiple vendor software versions.
Develops and applies skills to handle third-party integrations of other vendor products, systems, and protocols.
Takes a lead role in field coordination with installing subcontractors when a Project Engineer is not assigned.
Attends required field project coordination meetings and commissioning meetings as required by assigned projects.
Leads end user and customer system training on assigned projects.
Handles systematic project turnover from the construction phase to the Service team on all assigned projects.
Assists Design Engineers with validation of sequence of operations development against design build or contract requirements.
Coordinates with project staff to ensure accurate and timely recording of project costs, including time sheets and daily reports.
Manages field time and budgets for assigned projects.
Provides leadership for the field team when executing mid-sized projects requiring multiple team members.
Communicates clearly with team members on project issues, obstacles, and information needs.
Completes OSHA 10 and OSHA 30 safety training.
Follows safe work habits and meets office and project-specific safety program requirements.
Coaches and mentors junior-level Systems Software Engineers.
cond_0529.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Associate's degree in a technical field or 2–5 years of related work experience in building automation systems.
2–5 Years of experience in automation control systems, HVAC, construction, block coding, system software code testing, and Building Management Systems.
Working knowledge of MS Office, Windows, and file structure; basic TCP/IP network structure and web navigation.
Strong mechanical aptitude.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned tasks, and prioritize to meet project schedules.
Valid driver's license.
Preferred Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
Experience with LEED and Title 24.
Technical school training in a relevant field.
